assertion_review.fails_if: The scheduler call omits or changes its independent ten-second timeout.
Either scheduler row is missing or the known-present pre-existing memory value 37 is lost.
Running/end classification, cancelling uid or reason differs from independently specified literal values.
Output identity differs from JOB/NODE; these also parameterize input, so this checks preservation rather than independent identity discovery.
Timestamp does not follow seed or post-mortem memory is invented.
Minute delay count/length changes or accounting fallback is not called.
Removing terminal deduplication appends a fourth row.
Errors, absence, malformed answers or batch-step accounting produce no row or anything other than the three unknown literals.
An unreadable observation stops the reader or is misclassified instead of yielding unknown then sample.
Reason or node is lost; NODE appears in input too, so this is preservation coverage.
Removing the same-allocation guard loses the expected exception, or writing before refusal creates the directory.
Ignoring reader lock reaches a live scheduler query or creates a TSV.
Generated launch omits env unsetting, excluded node, target arguments or rigel; this inspects script generation and does not execute sbatch.
Written header differs from implementation constant; changing the shared constant moves both sides together and does not fail, as recorded in the finding.
Node append is missing, duplicated or misplaces source; input width comes from the implementation constant, so this alone does not pin the schema.
Either writer bypasses its resource lock or scheduler ownership lock is omitted.
A stopped reader leaves one row, demonstrably failing len==2 in negative-control.log, or the new row is not an end.
Any required emitted scheduler column is removed/renamed, differing from this independent exact-header literal.

findings.text: non-blocking: The schema assertion compares a header emitted from _HEALTH_COLUMNS with that same implementation constant, so deleting or renaming a required column on both sides leaves it green; tests/test_fleet_health.py:223 supplies an independent literal contract, so this weakness does not block delivery.
